a nonlinear mechanoreceptor model, combined with a nonlinear integrate-and-fire model can predict the afferent response to blood pressure changes in the rat.

the baroreceptor firing dynamics can be predicted using a modeling framework that combines a model for arterial deformation, receptor deformation and neural firing dynamics.

modeling the dynamics of the baroreceptor reflex.

the modeling of afferent dynamics of the baroreflex control system.
